This site is published in en, de, it.

- [Thomas Marco Zimmermann — Product Designer & Digital Product Strategist](https://tmz.it/en): Product Designer and Digital Product Strategist with 30+ years experience building digital platforms across Europe. Founder of GoRow, No!Logo and Nimito. Former Oracle and Reply consultant.

## Pages (de)

- [Thomas Marco Zimmermann — Product Designer & Digital Product Strategist](https://tmz.it/de): Product Designer und Digital Product Strategist mit über 30 Jahren Erfahrung im Aufbau digitaler Plattformen in ganz Europa. Gründer von GoRow, No!Logo und Nimito. Ehemals Berater bei Oracle und Reply.
- [Cookie-Richtlinie](https://tmz.it/de/cookie-richtlinie)

## Pages (it)

- [Thomas Marco Zimmermann — Product Designer & Stratega di prodotti digitali](https://tmz.it/it): Product Designer e stratega di prodotti digitali, oltre 30 anni a costruire piattaforme digitali in tutta Europa. Fondatore di GoRow, No!Logo e Nimito. Già consulente in Oracle e Reply.
- [Cookie policy](https://tmz.it/it/cookie-policy)
- [Note legali](https://tmz.it/it/note-legali)
- [Informativa sulla privacy](https://tmz.it/it/privacy)

## Blog

## Catalogue

- [Douglas Adams](https://tmz.it/en/books/douglas-adams): One of my preferred authors
- [The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy](https://tmz.it/en/books/the-hitchhiker-s-guide-to-the-galaxy): It’s an ordinary Thursday morning for Arthur Dent... until his house gets demolished. The Earth follows shortly after to make way for a new hyperspace express route, and Arthur’s best friend has just announced that he’s an alien.
- [The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy](https://tmz.it/en/books/the-hitchhiker-s-guide-to-the-galaxy-special-edition): This special 42nd Anniversary Edition features exclusive bonus material from the Douglas Adams archives, along with an introduction by Doctor Who showrunner Russell T Davies.

An international sensation and beloved pop-culture classic, The Hitchhiker’s Guide to the Galaxy has taken many forms, from radio and television to novels, theatre, comics, and film. Following the extraordinary—and often hilariously chaotic—adventures of Arthur Dent across the galaxy, Douglas Adams’ iconic creation continues to entertain and inspire curious minds around the world.
- [Good Omens](https://tmz.it/en/books/good-omens): A comic novel about an angel and a demon trying to prevent the end of the world.
- [The Boy, the Mole, the Fox and the Horse](https://tmz.it/en/books/the-boy-the-mole-the-fox-and-the-horse): An illustrated story of friendship and kindness.
- [Unveiled](https://tmz.it/en/books/unveiled): A memoir of growing up under radical Islam and leaving it behind.
- [Enshittification](https://tmz.it/en/books/enshittification)
